title: Add a comment about duplicated information.
description:
The wtap_rec structure contains a wtap_block t, and some stuff in the
wtap_block_t may duplicate, or should perhaps replace, stuff in the
rec_header union's members.

Fix up some other comments.  and clean up some white space issues while
we're at it.

commits_data.message:
Add a comment about duplicated information.

The wtap_rec structure contains a wtap_block t, and some stuff in the
wtap_block_t may duplicate, or should perhaps replace, stuff in the
rec_header union's members.

Fix up some other comments.  and clean up some white space issues while
